milestone: W8 near-ceiling webcam freshness characterization — arrival-jitter-margin rerun
objective: Fresh W8 replacement for consumed attempt 003. Keep the proven camera/transform/typed Host and 40 ms Host backstop, but use a 50 ms ACK-gated client dispatch-start floor so variable localhost request latency cannot shrink Host frame-start spacing below 40 ms. Characterize sustainable FPS/freshness once; no rate ladder, pipelining, retry, reconnect or reclaim.

readiness.required_followup: Execute only scripts/run_webcam_w8_rerun_windows.ps1 once while this exact one-use grant remains live. Never replay 003 or reuse any prior grant.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target; no target override

transport.connection_shape: one connection; one frame in flight; one ACK per frame
transport.one_controller_rule: After a fresh named grant only: stop the MCP product supervisor and verify its session closed; Android Divoom app disconnected. OpenTivoo and port 8779 untouched. Restore MCP separately under its existing Runtime 003 policy after terminal close.

build.identity_note: W8-004 runner rebuilt/staged. Unsafe 40 ms arrival-jitter control reproduced the 003 failure; corrected 50 ms control passed the same skew. Parity and real read-only Host status checks passed; Host/Runtime 003 unchanged; no claim/session/device I/O.

session.shape: ACK-gated W8 rerun with a 50 ms absolute client dispatch-start floor against the unchanged 40 ms Host streaming backstop. The 10 ms margin covers measured variable localhost request-arrival latency; one prior ACK is always required, packet spacing remains zero, and pipelining is forbidden.

stream.source_description: NexiGo VID_0C45 PID_2690 live camera; WinRT Realtime freshest-frame slots; fixed srgb_area transform and deterministic 255-colour guard

live_source.producer_description: W8-004 Windows-native camera/transform/encoder + typed-session adapter. Same proven W7/W8 transport; 50 ms client floor is the only pacing correction after 003 demonstrated that equal 40 ms client/Host floors are unsafe under variable request-arrival latency. Source hashes frozen for review; Windows rebuilt binary must be frozen by prep.

camera.observed_rate_exception: Exposure-quantised 30 fps previously measured; see route section 11. Re-measure in trial preflight, do not promise 60 fps.

transform.palette_guard: closest weighted-colour pair, deterministic scan-order tie break, applied last

live_source.privacy: No saved camera stills or video; metrics only

budgets.derivation: min(floor(10000 / 50) + 1, 500) = 201 frames; 201 * 3 = 603 packets; canonical encoder worst-case is 1054 application bytes including both preambles, so 201 * 1054 = 211854 bytes.

stop_immediately_on: camera missing or no valid first frame before claim/open
Host profile not confirmed as streaming_ack_clock
target, firmware, source or executable hash mismatch
any Host refusal, HTTP/send fault or ACK timeout
malformed or unexpected report / canvas invalidation / stock takeover
10 second lifetime or frame/byte budget reached
stop_policy.on_camera_disconnect: Stop new submissions, allow an already-submitted frame to settle, request close once. Ambiguous close is unknown. Never resend, reconnect or reclaim.
stop_policy.on_host_fault: Terminal unknown; never resend or retry; cleanup must not overwrite unknown.
stop_policy.source_cleanup: Cancel capture/processor and dispose the reader/camera. Collection-continuation flag refers to existing MCP collection, not retaining webcam capture.
stop_policy.recovery: Restore the MCP product separately under Runtime 003 after verifying experiment terminal ownership; do not overlap controllers.

acceptance.transport: Characterize one clean 10-second run; zero retries/reconnects/reclaims/pacing refusals/encoder-hash mismatches; one frame in flight; queue depth max <=1; duplicate source frames = 0.
acceptance.rate: Target >=15.5 fps sustained. 13-15.5 fps is investigate-not-auto-fail if source freshness is excellent and transport is clean. The 50 ms client floor has a 20 fps theoretical scheduling ceiling; do not create a rate ladder.
acceptance.freshness: p95 source age at send <=80 ms target; inspect p95 by quarter for increasing age trend; latest-frame-wins replacement rate is measured, not treated as loss.
acceptance.timing: Report HTTP POST round-trip ACK timing, Host send-to-ACK timing, their bounded difference as localhost/serialization overhead estimate, and dispatch jitter separately. Do not call any of these optical latency.
acceptance.visual: Owner checks tearing/faults and whether the already-accepted webcam image remains usable at higher cadence.
acceptance.queue: Raw and processed slots are capacity one by construction; report observed max depth for both.

persistence_analysis.forbidden: firmware, gallery/persistent uploads, raw send, target selection, command enumeration, pipelining
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; Runtime 003 is not webcam authority

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE 10-second W8 replacement live-camera characterization to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 v42012 via existing typed Host 127.0.0.1:8796 and streaming_ack_clock profile; unchanged 40 ms Host floor plus 50 ms client dispatch-start floor (10 ms request-arrival jitter margin), at most 201 frames / 603 packets / 211854 application bytes; one connection and one frame in flight, zero packet spacing, no retry/reconnect/reclaim/pipelining; suspend and restore Runtime 003 separately. No rate ladder; attempts 001-003 grants may not be reused.

adapter.claim_handshake: Runner must produce one fresh valid 16x16 frame and emit camera_ready + nonce before WSL creates the durable one-use claim; only execute:<nonce> may cross the claim boundary.
adapter.deployment_state: PASS W8-004 preparation: rebuilt/staged/frozen with 50 ms arrival-jitter margin; no claim/session/device I/O.

w8_failed_baseline.diagnosis: Client dispatch spacing is not Host frame-start spacing; equal 40 ms floors provide no variable request-arrival latency margin.
